points.description: States that piggybacking requires a full-duplex or half-duplex (semi-duplex) connection, i.e. two-way communication between sender and receiver, so that data frames can also carry the acknowledgement (frames contain an additional field for the acknowledgement). Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating the need for two-way (duplex/semi-duplex) communication, or that frames carry an extra acknowledgement field. No mark for answers that do not mention bidirectional data flow or ack-carrying frames.
